words.definition: Relating to government revenue, especially taxes
words.definationTranslation: सरकारी राजस्व से संबंधित, विशेष रूप से करों

words.definition: A valuable resource owned by a person or organization

sentence.translation: सरकार लोगों को बचत करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित कर रही है।

words.definition: The system of levying taxes on individuals and organizations

sentence.sentence: The company is trying to minimize its taxation liability.
sentence.translation: कंपनी अपनी कराधान देयता को कम करने का प्रयास कर रही है।

words.definition: A payment for the use of money

words.definition: The ability to borrow money

sentence.sentence: The investor uses credit to finance his investments.

sentence.sentence: The government is trying to help debtors who are struggling to pay their debts.

words.definition: A person or organization that lends money

sentence.translation: साहूकार को ऋणी से भुगतान की मांग करने का अधिकार है।

sentence.sentence: The company is a creditor to several small businesses.

words.definition: A promise or assurance that something will happen or be done

sentence.sentence: The investor wants a guarantee on his investment.

words.definition: A system of protection against financial loss

sentence.sentence: The company offers a pension plan to its employees.
sentence.translation: कंपनी अपने कर्मचारियों के लिए एक पेंशन योजना प्रदान करती है।

words.definition: The state of being retired from work

sentence.sentence: The employee is planning for his retirement.
sentence.translation: कर्मचारी अपनी सेवानिवृत्ति की योजना बना रहा है।

sentence.sentence: The company offers a retirement plan to its employees.
sentence.translation: कंपनी अपने कर्मचारियों के लिए एक सेवानिवृत्ति योजना प्रदान करती है।
